text:
marta (Product Designer): quick design review — the 'Create API Key' modal feels cramped when orgs have many role tags. noticed overflow + keyboard focus issues 

sam (PM): +1 on overflow. Also getting copy confusion: users aren't sure if selected roles are final or editable later. can we make intent clearer? :thinking_face: 

dean (Frontend): I can repro the keyboard trap. If you tab from the role multiselect and hit enter, focus gets stuck in the chip list. likely trapped by the chip-focus handler.

anika (Accessibility): saw that too — NVDA reads "listbox" but doesn't announce chip counts or that chips are removable. aria-live message needed when roles added/removed.

marta (Product Designer): proposed layout: move scope summary up top, compact role pills, and an explicit "roles overview" button that opens a simple dialog (instead of huge dropdown) for >6 roles. thoughts?

sam (PM): sounds good. also want stronger warning copy when someone grants broad scopes (eg: admin.*). current warning is subtle.

dean (Frontend): quick fix for trap: ensure chip removal buttons are focusable and that multiselect emits a `focusout` when keyboard nav leaves. low-risk patch.

anika (Accessibility): suggest adding: `aria-live="polite"` region that says "X roles selected, use backspace to remove" and ensure the "Show secret" button has `aria-pressed` and a short accessible name.

marta (Product Designer): proposed copy for the warning (short):
```
Warning: This key will grant broad access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services.
Recommended: limit scopes and rotate regularly.
```

sam (PM): love the copy. can we add a small inline "why this matters" link that expands a one-line explanation? keeps modal short.

dean (Frontend): implementation note: expanded help can be a `details` element for keyboard users — or a custom disclosure that toggles `aria-expanded`. both fine.

anika (Accessibility): prefer the custom disclosure so we can control announcements. ensure it receives focus on expand. also contrast check: warning background (#FFF7E6) vs text — borderline for AA in small text. increase contrast or bold the text.

marta (Product Designer): new empty-state for API Keys page suggestion: "You don't have any keys yet — create one to get started" CTA primary + small help text about scopes. avoids overwhelming early users.

sam (PM): telemetry ask: add events for (create_modal_open, create_submit, role_overflow_open, warning_ack). helps measure friction.

dean (Frontend): will add telemetry hooks. also adding `data-testid` for QA.

anika (Accessibility): quick QA checklist for the change:
- focus order through modal (title -> scopes summary -> rolepicker -> create/revoke buttons)
- screen reader announcement on role add/remove
- disclosure announces when expanded
- visible focus indicators on chips and remove buttons

marta (Product Designer): action items:
1) dean: patch chip focus + add disclosure pattern — PR by EOD Thu
2) anika: draft accessible copy & checklist — review by Fri
3) sam: telemetry spec + wording for help popover
4) marta: mockups for overflow dialog (6+ roles) and updated empty state

sam (PM): also flag: rotation UX later — after this lands, we should validate that rotated keys keep the same role assignments and show a small timeline in the modal.

dean (Frontend): noted. will make the role assignment payload idempotent on rotate.

ci-bot: build passed for branch "fix/role-chip-focus" — 3 tests failing (a11y). linking build: https://ci.internal/reports/321

anika (Accessibility): will take the failing tests and iterate. probably focus order assertions.

marta (Product Designer): thanks all — will upload updated mockups to the thread when ready :thumbsup:
